schema_note: v2 (2026-10-28): each page has two nodes, the MMRS record and the entity it describes; relations are typed; each assertion carries a source and a basis (operator statement, third-party report, our observation, our reading); lifecycle is kept apart from the observation that saw it; roles are plural; properties answer traversal questions; holdings carry event, inclusion and observed dates.
